name: Syncthing
description: Continuous, encrypted, peer-to-peer file synchronization between your devices.
compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: syncthing/syncthing:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8384"
      - "${{cfg.sync_port}}:22000/tcp"
      - "${{cfg.sync_port}}:22000/udp"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/syncthing
    restart: unless-stopped
